note_tweet.text:
❗️BIOHAZARD, a Resident Evil 7 Fan Film, is officially out and available to watch!

✍️ Written and directed by Chandler Riggs (Carl Grimes in The Walking Dead), the short film also stars Jason Douglas (Tobin in The Walking Dead).

The movie is about Ethan Winters searching for his missing wife and getting trapped by the Baker family.

The team transformed a former cigar factory in Tampa Bay into part of the Baker estate, using practical sets, effects and stunts with minimal VFX.

🎬 Cast: Chandler Riggs, Jason Douglas, Mary Rachel Quinn, Eugenie Bondurant, Sam Coyles and Mia Cole.

• Produced by Shane Brady and Emily Zercher
• Cinematography by Brian M. Tang
• Production design by Brandon Agan
• Music by Alexander Taylor

The film is a noncommercial fan project made without AI.

Watch here: https://t.co/osLcoDKx4g
